A '''Radionic Sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It was one of the many [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] types installed on the [[Fromm Tower Droid]]. [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] were equipped with advanced Radionic Sensors. The sensors were also installed on [[DZ-70 fugitive tracker droid]]s and [[Hound-W2 SPD]]s.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
